propositions: Bridge orchestration must be packaged as runner-neutral Python core exposed through three public surfaces: library (rebar.bridge_run), CLI (rebar bridge run), and MCP (typed write-gated tool).
The packaged runner must work from all three install paths: pip wheel, Homebrew wheel-backed environment, and MCP Registry/uvx, with no repository-local runner script required.

Five execution profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) must preserve legacy MODE environment variable compatibility while using canonical 'profile' noun in public interfaces.

Legacy direct callers must retain benign results (3/4/75) unchanged; only the new provider runner maps benign legacy results to canonical 0, while operational failures (1) and invalid invocations (2) are preserved.

Every successful non-paused provider pass must invoke strict delivery with run id, bot identity, and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always; delivery failure returns 1 with diagnostics and exact valid pause markers skip delivery.

GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab provider wrappers must invoke exactly 'rebar bridge run', be schema-validated, pass pinned ShellCheck linting, and use immutable vendored schemas with verified provenance.
